snippet.title: Whispers of the Eyeless || Full Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
BUY NOW ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2523890/Whispers_of_the_Eyeless/

Whispers of the Eyeless is a dark fantasy strategy RPG where you build a cult, unleash divine powers, and endure psychological trials. Command disciples, outwit enemies in tactical turn-based battles, and determine the fate of Aranthor as you awaken the Dead Gods — Wrath, Desire, and Madness.

►Main Website: https://www.hearthewhispers.com
►Discord: https://discord.gg/bqd5vSDkYV
